arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Ratner stated the Ninth Circuit found any role suffices.
Mr. Chemerinsky argued statutory language implies but-for causation.
Justice Kagan questioned whether the opposing sides must prove but-for causation.
Chief Justice Roberts suggested the legal distinction might be academic.
